definition: **慢性肺栓塞 CT 徵象包括：鈣化血栓、transpleural systemic collateral vessels（如 intercostal arteries）、bilateral lower lobe peripheral linear opacities（= organized infarcts/fibrosis）。**
keyPoints: **Transpleural systemic collateral vessels**（intercostal / internal mammary arteries）代償
**Multiple peripheral linear opacities** in lower lobes（organized pulmonary infarcts）
其他：mosaic perfusion、web/band in PA、PA enlargement、RV hypertrophy
name: Chronic Pulmonary Thromboembolism CT Signs
